name: Occasion Engine for Autotelex
author: marcelkraan

sections.description:
The Occasion Engine for Autotelex is a bridge between the Autotelex B2B platform and your WordPress website. This plugin quickly converts incoming XML vehicle data into conversion-optimized vehicle pages without depending on your theme.

Perfect for car dealerships seeking independence and a professional, high-speed inventory presentation.

Key Features

  • Fully Automated Import: Processes Autotelex XML pings directly via the secure WordPress REST API.
  • Responsive Grid with Filters: Display your inventory anywhere using the [occasion_overzicht] shortcode. Includes AJAX-friendly filters (Make, Body, Fuel, Transmission, Color).
  • Dynamic License Plates: Automatically detects imported vehicles and visually adjusts the license plate colors based on the country of origin.
  • Mobile-Optimized Gallery: Uses advanced CSS and flexbox rendering for a smooth swipe gallery on mobile devices.
  • Server Storage Optimization: Automatically removes attached vehicle photos from the server once a car is marked as sold or deleted via the feed.
  • API Activity Log: Built-in dashboard logging for quick troubleshooting.
  • SEO Optimized: Automatically generates strong meta-titles and integrates seamlessly with SEO plugins.

External services

This plugin displays vehicle information and images retrieved from the Autotelex / Hexon API.
The vehicle images shown in the grid and on the single vehicle pages are loaded and served directly from Autotelex’s external servers.
This plugin does not send any personal visitor data from your website to Autotelex.

This service is provided by Autotelex:
* Terms of Service: https://www.autotelex.nl/Voorwaarden
* Privacy Policy: https://www.autotelex.nl/Privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the occasion-engine-for-autotelex folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install the ZIP via the WordPress dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the new menu item in your dashboard (Occasions > Settings & API).
  4. Create an Application Password and copy the Webhook URL into your Autotelex B2B portal.
  5. Place the [occasion_overzicht] shortcode on any page to display your active inventory.
sections.faq:
Do I need a specific theme?

No. The plugin is built to function independently of any theme and loads its own robust flexbox stylesheets.

How secure is the import feed?

Extremely secure. The API endpoint only accepts requests containing a valid Application Password from a user with Editor capabilities or higher.
